content.text: Onset: MC within 2wks of drug initiation, has also occurred immediately after high-dose injection
Mechanism: D2 receptor blockade in hypothalamus, nigrostriatal pathways, & spinal cord leads to ↑ muscle rigidity & tremor via extrapyramidal pathways
S/SXS: altered mental status (agitation, delirium, confusion), “lead pipe” muscle rigidity, fever & diaphoresis, autonomic instability (tachycardia, HTN, tachypnea)

TX: ICU admit, D/C causative agent, aggressive supportive care (cardiorespiratory, IVF, cooling blankets, antihypertensives [Clonidine, Nitroprusside], UFH/LMWH for DVT prevention, BDZs for agitation if necessary)
